coach_note: Tue Nov 24 - long walk, push-ups, and 5th Street. Yesterday's jog put 40 Zone 2 minutes in the bank and the planks closed the week's plank goal, so today's walk is pure Zone 1 - no need to chase a heart rate. Push-ups come back with all three variants, each doing a different job now: decline is the strength set (35 last time), flat is the volume set (50), and incline turns into a slow close-grip tricep set instead of a lighter chest set. Pulling work restarts gently - you did 7-8 strict pull-ups in August, so the strength is there; today is dead hangs and slow negatives, nothing to failure, with the first real pull-ups coming back in a week or two. No hamstring work, and sit-ups replace the crunch machine.

exercises.note: 90 minutes, conversational pace. Do this first so everything after is done warm - that matters most for the hanging and negatives.

Set 1 decline AMRAP with the feet higher than last time (bench or step, not the curb) - 35 at the old height means it's time. Rest 2 min. Set 2 flat AMRAP (50 last time; beating it isn't the point, logging it is). Set 3 incline, close grip (hands inside the shoulders), 3 seconds down, pause at the bottom - stop around 15 or when the elbows flare. Three different exercises now, not one at three heights.

DEAD HANGS, logged here with the dead-hang variant and a time, not reps. Two hangs, shoulders packed (pull them down away from the ears, don't just dangle), 30-45 seconds each or until the grip starts to open. Rest 90 s between. This is grip, shoulder and lat loading with no pull at all.

One set of 4. Jump or step to the top, lower over a full 5 seconds, step off, reset. NOT to failure - if the 4th rep drops faster than 3 seconds, stop at 3. The slow lower is where the strength comes from and it's gentler on the back than pulling up, because nothing is yanked.
Two sets at the setting you used on Nov 8 (20) - second set AMRAP. Squeeze the shoulder blades, no leaning back.
Last time 40 x15 x2. One set at 40, then one AMRAP at 40 - if that passes 20, the next setting is fine.
One set, moderate, stop with a few left - shoulders at the bottom of a dip are the one place not to go to failure. Only go as deep as the upper arm being parallel to the ground.
Replaces the crunch machine from now on. One AMRAP set, hands across the chest (not behind the head), curl up rather than yank - then one set of 15.
Fixed 2 x 20 as before - lower back, not an AMRAP exercise.
